content:
mia: Heads-up — planning to launch the search + retarget campaign for the webinar next Tue. Need a quick checklist: creative rotation, benchmark goals, budget pacing, and inbound routing to the webinar flow. :rocket:
sam: Sounds good. Goal reminder: CPL target $85, webinar registrants = 1.2k over 2 weeks. Allocate $18k/week to search + retarget combined. :chart_with_upwards_trend:
jun: typo — jen?
jen: that's me :) for creative: we should rotate 4 headlines + 3 descriptions per ad group. Can we do a canary with last-click vs. first-click UTM to see attribution drift? :eyes:
oliver: On bids: start with tCPA-like pacing but cap max CPC at $12 for high-intent keywords. For retargeting, 14-day window, 3 impressions/day cap. Frequency cap only on display retarget. :white_check_mark:
mia: Good. For messaging iteration: primary: "Run LLM inferencing reliably at production scale" secondary: webinar hook = "Live demo + cost optimization playbook". Want 2 landing variants (short form vs. long form).
sam: Inbound routing — send leads via webhook to HubSpot, then route MQLs to SDR queue if lead_score >= 70. Can we add a fallback email notify if webhook fails?
oliver: Yep. HubSpot webhook config snippet below. We also need the UTM template.

oliver: ```
POST https://hooks.hubspot.com/forms/v2/submissions
Headers: {"Content-Type": "application/json"}
Body: {"fields":[{"name":"email","value":"{{email}}"},{"name":"firstname","value":"{{first}}"}],"context":{"hutk":"{{hubspot_cookie}}","pageUri":"{{landing_url}}","pageName":"Webinar: Serving LLMs"}}
```

jen: UTM scheme: utm_source=paid&utm_medium=search&utm_campaign=webinar_serving_llms_2026&utm_content={{creative_id}}. Use utm_term for keyword. Keep tag length <= 100 chars.

mia: Nice. CampaignBot, can you schedule creative upload and a short QA run on staging landing? :pray:
campaign-bot: Creative upload scheduled for 2026-05-04T14:00Z. Staging QA tests: 1) tracking pixels fire, 2) form posts to HubSpot webhook, 3) variant A/B displays correct hero. Report will be posted to #ads-qa.
sam: For benchmarks: set monitoring alerts if CPC > 1.5x expected or CTR < 0.6% for search. Also log rolling 24h CPL; pause any ad group that trips the pause rule 3x in 48h.
jen: Creative refresh cadence: swap one headline every 72 hours for the first week, then drop worst-performing creative after 7 days. Use creative_id tagging in analytics so we can tie to registration CRO.
oliver: Will add frequency and retarget list sizes to sheet. Can someone confirm the retarget seed: 30-day site visitors excluding current customers?
mia: Confirmed. Exclude logged-in users (customer tag). Also include recent trialers but put them into a higher bid tier.
sam: Quick ask: can growth run a short search auction snapshot tomorrow to get live CPC estimates for the top 20 keywords?
jen: I'm on it. I'll share the snapshot CSV and highlight 5 headline swaps to try. :thumbsup:

mia: Perfect. Final ask: everyone add their checkboxes to the launch playbook doc — https://docs.redwood.com/marketing/launch-playbooks/webinar-llm-serving — by EOD Friday. I'll run a pre-launch call Monday 10am PT. :calendar:
